title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 083 ]

blocks.text: Some people carry on active social lives with computers - their own or the ones available at terminals in public places like cafes, social centers, libraries, etc. Communicating with others on "bulletin boards", they get to know people they might never meet in the traditional way. For example, a graduate student in San Francisco, California, has made more than fifty "net friends", including a homeless vegetarian who gets around on roller-blades, an HIV-positive police officer, some members of an Iranian family, an 80-year-old detective, and a medical geneticist who studies DNA. She has gone out on dates with about ten of her "network contacts". In fact, she almost married one. The romance didn't last. However, she doesn't blame the computer for breaking up the relationship.

readingSentences.english: Some people carry on active social lives with computers - their own or the ones available at terminals in public places like cafes, social centers, libraries, etc.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 사람들은 컴퓨터로 활발한 사교 생활을 한다. 자기 컴퓨터를 쓰기도 하고, 카페나 사교 센터, 도서관 같은 공공장소의 단말기를 쓰기도 한다.

readingSentences.english: Communicating with others on "bulletin boards", they get to know people they might never meet in the traditional way.
readingSentences.korean: "게시판"에서 다른 사람들과 소통하면서, 그들은 전통적인 방법으로는 결코 만나지 못했을 사람들을 알게 된다.

readingSentences.english: For example, a graduate student in San Francisco, California, has made more than fifty "net friends", including a homeless vegetarian who gets around on roller-blades, an HIV-positive police officer, some members of an Iranian family, an 80-year-old detective, and a medical geneticist who studies DNA.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어 캘리포니아주 샌프란시스코의 한 대학원생은 롤러블레이드를 타고 다니는 노숙인 채식주의자, HIV 양성인 경찰관, 이란인 가족 몇 명, 80세 탐정, DNA를 연구하는 의학 유전학자를 포함해 50명이 넘는 "인터넷 친구"를 사귀었다.

readingSentences.english: She has gone out on dates with about ten of her "network contacts".
readingSentences.korean: 그녀는 "인터넷에서 알게 된 사람" 가운데 열 명쯤과 데이트를 했다.

readingSentences.english: In fact, she almost married one.
readingSentences.korean: 실제로 그중 한 명과는 결혼할 뻔했다.

readingSentences.english: However, she doesn't blame the computer for breaking up the relationship.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그녀는 관계가 깨진 것을 컴퓨터 탓으로 돌리지 않는다.
